provenance.equation: Driven Wang-Buzsaki fast-spiking interneuron: 50 inner dt=0.01 sub-steps per 0.5 ms macro step advanced with the sequential (Gauss-Seidel) forward Euler the schema declares (gating variables h, n updated from the old voltage, then the membrane voltage v from the new gates; sodium activation instantaneous via m_inf = alpha_m/(alpha_m+beta_m) with alpha_m = 1/exprel(-(v+35)/10)). The rising-edge v >= v_threshold crossing is evaluated only on the macro boundary (no reset). numpy exp/expm1 match the runner bit-for-bit; independently re-derived from the Wang-Buzsaki (1996) model definition.
